prompt_text: Write a C solution for the HackerRank problem Array Pairs.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution uses a nested loop leading to O(n^2) time complexity, which is too slow for large constraints (n up to 100000).
bug_analysis.root_cause: Inefficient brute-force approach instead of using optimized divide-and-conquer or segment tree method.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Double nested loop over array elements
